text:
jen: Draft of the product launch post is up: https://docs.google.com/redwood/dedicated-launch-draft. Quick ask — can everyone do a claims scrub vs our benchmark numbers? I want legal + data signoff before we schedule publish (target Fri 9:00am PT).

omar: on it. which metric do you want highlighted? 95th token latency or end-to-end generation?

ravi: I can provide the numbers. latest run (dedicated pool, small-batch priming): 95th per-token latency = 420 ms, median = 60 ms, throughput = 8.2k tokens/s. Ran on A100-80GB, 64 token average.

jen: perfect — legal needs the exact phrasing to avoid absolute claims. lucy, will that work?

lucy: prefer conservative wording. Suggest: "as measured in our internal benchmarks, 95th percentile per-token latency was 420 ms under test conditions." Also need a link to the raw test and a short caveats paragraph (test conditions, synthetic prompts).

ravi: raw logs and run metadata: https://internal.redwood/bench/2026-03-15-dedicated-a100. Caveats: synthetic prompts, no noisy network variance, tuned kernel selection.

jen: adding that link into the draft. omar — can you craft a one-sentence benchmark callout for the hero that avoids superlatives?

omar: how about: "Redwood Dedicated provides predictable inference economics and sub-second per-token latency in our internal benchmarks." short and neutral.

lucy: tweak to: "sub-second per-token latency in our internal benchmarks" (explicit, still conservative).

ravi: "sub-second" is accurate for 420 ms — good from data side.

matt: Growth note — we'll need UTMs and the demo funnel mapping. Proposed UTM: utm_source=blog&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=redwood-dedicated-launch. Also add a hidden field `demo_intent` to the form for routing.

kate: webinar/demo ops — we want the blog CTA to route registrants to two flows: enterprise demo queue (AE follow-up) and nurture (emails + webinar). Form mapping I need: `demo_tier` values -> enterprise|mid-market|self-serve. Can Marketing confirm what triggers enterprise?

jen: rule: requests that indicate >=5 seats or mentions "SAML"/"on-prem" -> enterprise. Otherwise mid-market or self-serve. I'll add a short checkbox line to capture seat count.

kate: mapping created in HubSpot. Workflow: if `demo_tier` == enterprise -> assign to queue `AE-Demos`; if mid-market -> assign `Growth-Engage`; self-serve -> automated nurture list. I can share the workflow screenshot.

matt: also want a hidden param `pref_demo_time` for follow-up personalization.

jen: good. back to copy — legal needs sign-off EOD today. lucy, can you give a final yes/no?

lucy: I can approve provided we keep the bench phrasing and include the link + caveats. Send me the final draft with the exact bench sentence and the small callout copy.

jen: will do. action items I have: 1) insert exact bench sentence from ravi, 2) add raw log link and caveats, 3) wire UTMs (matt), 4) wire HubSpot form mapping (kate), 5) legal sign-off (lucy).

ravi: exact bench sentence you can paste: `95th percentile per-token latency: 420 ms (test conditions: 1k prompts, 64-token average, A100-80GB, dedicated pool)`

jen: pasted into draft. lucy — I've updated the doc. Link above.

lucy: looks good. small wording tweak in hero callout: change "predictable inference economics" -> "predictable inference costs". Approving once that's updated.

jen: changed. final checklist: lucy approve (waiting), kate confirm HubSpot mapping (done), matt finalize UTMs (done), ravi confirm bench sentence (done).

publishbot: publish scheduled for Fri 09:00 PT. Publishing will be blocked until legal sign-off. 

jen: thanks all — if no objections by EOD, I'll flip the publish hold and notify design to lock hero image. :tada:
